meta.title: Taskboard · Storage
meta.description:
The one replaceable layer of the taskboard: it flushes in-memory cards to disk.

It does exactly one thing: build a CardStore implementation and register it as the taskboard3Store service. The default comes from @taskboard/io (SQLite). The data directory comes from the required dataDir config option, which has no default of its own; the bundled patch points it at the DSH data directory via dshHomePath, and any other entry point (such as the MCP constructor) must pass it explicitly.

It knows nothing about the card state machine, templates, search or permission decisions. Search belonged here in an early version and was later folded into core; it is not this layer’s duty now. Filtering and ordering are pure functions in core, not here.

Switch it off and the taskboard3Store service is unavailable, so the whole taskboard stays quietly inactive instead of failing. To use another persistence implementation, switch this row off and install a plugin that registers the same taskboard3Store service — no layer above changes.
